output.reason: The brief fits the evidence I have: the Phase 2 night staffing cut, probes keyed in at confirmation rather than at unload, Haverlow's dispatch temperatures, and an unmonitored dock. It also adds specific dwell-time and night-shift-versus-day-shift data that point to the dock wait, and it gives clear next steps (restore night dock-to-chamber time and stop the chargeback) while being honest that the Corriebank share is still unresolved.
